text_block_list.text: (Shhhhh...)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—As expected, Mr. C.B. is the fan favorite here.
Look at all those banners waving for her.

text_block_list.name: Commentator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
"I have high hopes for her as well.
After all, both her parents had such spectacular, legendary careers—"

text_block_list.name: Commentator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
"Mr. C.B. is definitely going to win today.
...I really hope she wins the Derby, too."

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Will I win? I wonder...
What if I lose...?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
No, it's okay!
Mr. C.B. will definitely win for us...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the turf was in quite a state.
I bet everyone'll be covered in mud once they finish running.
choice_data_list: Just make sure you don't get hurt, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah.
I don't wanna be unable to run for a while either.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though,
it's my first race against our ace today.
I can't help getting hyped—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Speak of the devil.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ceeee Beeeeee!!

Turning around at the piercing shout,
there was Katsuragi Ace,
glaring and sprinting right toward me.

Bursting inside with great momentum, Katsuragi Ace—
bowed her head deeply, very deeply.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, today!
I'm looking forward to working with you!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, jeez!
You really are strange!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hah!? You of all people are saying that!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's it, lift your head up, Ace.
And then, like this, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Nice to meet you!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Do you not like handshakes?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, woooaaah!
Don't mess with meeee!!!

Katsuragi Ace forcefully took her right hand.
Though she was trembling slightly, her eyes were locked straight onto Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's make this a great race, CB...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks to you, I'm really looking forward to it.

The grand spring spectacle drenched in pouring rain—
The Satsuki Sho begins.
